requested_by_owner: Respect native WebRTC/SIP media and signaling conventions while consolidating Connect control in UCTP and media on declared UCTP/QUIC paths.
review_scope: Source and primary standards review only; no interoperability test or architecture rewrite performed.

invariants.title: One canonical control model
invariants.requirement: UCTP owns the canonical Connect application command/event model, journal, authorization, operation identity and recovery. Adapters preserve native signaling state machines and translate their observations into this model. Do not create a competing permission or ownership authority inside an adapter.

invariants.title: Native WebRTC peer semantics
invariants.requirement: A WebRTC peer retains RTCPeerConnection SDP offer/answer, ICE, DTLS-SRTP and negotiated RTP/RTCP semantics. UCTP carries Connect control/signaling through its declared transport. The browser RTC peer leg must not be described or tested as native QUIC.

invariants.title: Native SIP peer semantics
invariants.requirement: SIP adapters retain transactions, dialogs, offer/answer, negotiated codec/payload mappings and RTP/SRTP media. A SIP acceptance or dialog event is not proof of decoded media readiness. Preserve original transaction/effect identity across uncertainty.

invariants.title: Explicit UCTP/QUIC media profile
invariants.requirement: Use the architecture’s declared UCTP/QUIC media paths for native transport and browser WebTransport. Reliable control streams and low-latency media datagrams remain distinct. At a WebRTC/SIP-to-QUIC bridge, explicitly map negotiated media/identity/timing rather than assuming the external peer speaks QUIC. Keep local Core processing local where the architecture declares an in-process path; do not add a network hop to satisfy a label.

invariants.title: Preparation is separate from activation
invariants.requirement: Prepare bounded transport/codec resources independently while the old authorized media route remains usable. Before one public activation, acquire fresh current authority for the exact source/recipient/owner/generation and verify usable audio plus a decoded keyframe where video is required. SDP/ICE/SIP/queue success alone is insufficient.

invariants.title: No control-bookkeeping interruption
invariants.requirement: Admitted media uses immutable exact grants plus bounded local current-generation/expiry and IO lease checks. Positive Data attribution, identical replay and pure status/journal/metric changes must not invalidate unchanged media. No per-packet SQL policy traversal or control lock wait.

invariants.title: Real changes fence only affected media
invariants.requirement: Credential/key/device/identity/endpoint expiry or withdrawal, membership/role loss, terminal Session/Conversation, actual selected-stream audience/gate/codec or ownership/generation changes invalidate affected source/target/Session/medium/direction and dependent mixed/forwarded output. Stop new affected IO and drain owned IO as required. Unrelated admitted routes remain live. Never revive old buffered epochs.

invariants.title: Original operations, bounded waits and honest uncertainty
invariants.requirement: Keep immutable logical root/effect IDs and original cutoffs. Temporary Busy permits only a fresh authorization attempt for the same owned candidate at the proven admission boundary; never repeat uncertain physical preparation, activation or effects. Do not retain SQL/domain writer custody across signaling waits. Actual packet IO custody lasts through its bounded write.

invariants.title: Media timing, ordering and feedback remain valid
invariants.requirement: Preserve explicit codec/payload-type, SSRC, sequence, timestamp, source-generation and RTCP sender-report clock mapping. Distinguish reordering from loss, honor keyframe startup/recovery and transport-appropriate feedback/congestion behavior. Do not fabricate source clocks or let reliable control delivery stall media; re-encode/mix only when the declared bridge requires it.

invariants.title: Distinct movement operations
invariants.requirement: ICE restart, QUIC network-path migration, device handoff and server/adapter replacement are different operations with different ownership/state transitions. Tests must exercise the actual operation and original owner retirement; success of one does not qualify another.

invariants.title: Capabilities and qualification stay honest
invariants.requirement: The current browser RTC profile explicitly refuses Data and subscription changes requiring new-resource renegotiation. Check fixture expectations against declared profiles; do not claim support, silently downgrade, or add new Gate6 scope without reviewing the contract. SIP interoperability remains an architecture invariant; G6-054 stays parked and no new provider/PSTN rehearsal is authorized here.

source_anchors.behavior: Real RTCPeerConnection, WebSocket control and explicit Data refusal.
Actual SDP offer and remote-answer application.
Original physical peer and current binding/generation admission.
Existing-port selection; explicit refusal when resource renegotiation is required.

acceptance: Coordinator and independent reviewer verify applicable A01–A11 for each fix. This document does not change protocol capabilities, test criteria or historical verdicts.
